name: vLLM#40677: FlashInfer head_size not supported on Blackwell SM120
notes: Gemma-4 fails when forcing FLASHINFER attention backend on Blackwell SM120 (RTX PRO 6000). Error: head_size not supported. Gemma-4 config: head_dim=256, global_head_dim=512. Works with TRITON_ATTN. Affects base model, FP8, and NVFP4 checkpoints. Demonstrates hardware-specific kernel compatibility issues.
